text: Hedge fund contagion is defined as correlation over and above what one would expect from economic fundamentals, and clusters of suboptimal returns across investment styles count as contagion precisely because known risk factors for hedge fund performance cannot explain them.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Timothy A. Krause, Hedge Funds and Systemic Risk (2016). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=2748096
abstract: Because risk factors associated with hedge fund performance cannot explain such clusters, they can reflect contagion (Boyson et. al. 2010).

value: definition adopted from Bekaert, Harvey, and Ng (2005)
